A clean, straight-on printed SINGLE-ELIMINATION tournament BRACKET for 'MERIDIAN CUP - Knockout Bracket': 8 entrants in 4 Quarterfinals on the left, 2 Semifinals in the middle, a Final on the right, then the Champion. Rules of advancement: the WINNER of each match ADVANCES to the connected next-round match. Quarterfinal results:
  QF1: Adler vs Boyd  -> winner Adler
  QF2: Cole vs Diaz  -> winner Diaz
  QF3: Ellis vs Frost  -> winner Ellis
  QF4: Gomez vs Hale  -> winner Hale

The Final is those two semifinal winners, and the Champion is Adler. Highlight each match's winner. The two names in each next-round match MUST be the winners advancing from the previous round. Print the full bracket with the champion. Render it on plain white paper in portrait orientation with thin black ruled lines and a bold black header, like a clean office printout, photographed straight-on.
